newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African wool prices rise at latest auction.
newsitem.headline: S.African wool prices rise at latest auction.

text.p: South African wool prices were higher at the latest weekly auction, the Wool Board said.
It said 6,592 bales were offered at this week's sale, of which 96.2 percent was sold.

Price quotes for long Merino fleeces of 20 micron rose 1.7 percent, 21 micron rose 4.3 percent, 22 micron rose 3.4 percent, 23 micron rose 4.7 percent, 24 micron rose 4.4 percent and 25 micron rose 5.2 percent.
Prices for Merino bellies rose 2.0 percent, Merino lambs rose 2.3 percent and Merino locks fell 3.2 percent.
The offering included 1,857 bales of other White Wools, 1,381 bales of Ciskei/Transkei, 2,061 bales of Lesotho and 1,261 bales of coarse and coloured.
All of the 20, 22, 24 and 25 micron bales were sold. Of the 850 bales of 21 micron offered, 98.1 percent was sold. Of the 495 bales of 23 micron offered, 99.0 percent was sold.
The next sale will take place on March 5, when 11,900 bales will be on offer.
